en.heading: International Day of Charity
en.story: An act of solidarity may begin with practical help, but charity also has a collective dimension through organizations, services and shared responsibility. The date of 5 September is associated with Mother Teresa of Calcutta. The day invites reflection on dignity, mutual support and people's real needs.
en.origin: The official international observances calendar lists this date as 5 September and references A/RES/67/105. That record identifies an institutional observance, but it does not by itself establish a verified individual proposer or the complete history behind the date.
en.purpose: The observance creates an opportunity to explore the subject through original sources, testimony and reliable initiatives while distinguishing the history of the issue from the establishment of the day.
facts: The institutional observances calendar lists 5 September.
The cited decision reference is A/RES/67/105; the original establishing instrument and its year still require individual verification.
